items.title: Using AWS Backup to resynchronize a SQL Server AlwaysOn Availability Group
items.summary: Learn how to use AWS Backup to rebuild a failed secondary replica in a SQL Server AlwaysOn Availability Group on Amazon EC2. We walk through capturing an application-consistent snapshot, restoring the EC2 instance, rejoining the Availability Group, and handling a broken LSN chain to reduce recovery time compared to a manual backup and restore.
items.creator: Gabriel Pereira

items.title: AI-driven database investigation using MCP, Agent Skills, and AWS DevOps Agent
items.summary: Learn how to connect Amazon RDS for SQL Server diagnostic tools to AWS DevOps Agent through Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway. MCP tools run in AWS Lambda behind a governed Gateway endpoint, and an investigation skill encodes your DBA team's method so the agent can triage alarms and run autonomous, auditable database investigations.
items.creator: Sudhir Amin
